scope.quote: The ``TrailsIntentEntrypoint contract`` is designed to work with Sequence v3 wallets (smart contract wallets) but uses ECDSA.recover() for signature validation, which only works with EOA (Externally Owned Account) signatures. This makes the contract completely incompatible with its intended user base - smart contract wallets.
This fails when user is a smart contract wallet (like Sequence), because:
Smart wallets require EIP-1271 (isValidSignature) to validate signatures.
The contract is completely unusable by its intended primary user base as stated in the doc: Sequence v3 wallets.
